description: Comprehensive Physical Podoben Invocation Concordance for 1761 Pochayiv Menaion — Vol. 6: February (Pochayiv Lavra, 1761)

families.prescribed_model: Beholding the beauty of thy virginity
When the stone had been sealed
Having risen on the third day
Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross
Having laid aside all earthly hope
What shall we call you, O holy ones
He Who adorned the heaven with stars
He Who adorned the heaven with stars

А҆́гница, а҆́гнца ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ на дре́вѣ просте́рта во́лею кре́стнѣмъ, вопїѧ́ше мт҃рски, и҆ болѣ́знꙋющи съ пла́чемъ: сн҃е мо́й, что̀ стра́нное сїѐ видѣ́нїе? ко́мъ живо́тъ даѧ́й ꙗ҆́кѡ гдⷭ҇ь, ка́кѡ оу҆мерщвлѧ́ешися долготерпѣли́ве, земны̑мъ подаѧ̀ воскресе́нїе?
O Lord, though Thou didst stand before the tribunal
Weep Not for Me, O Mother
While the soldiers were guarding Thy tomb
With the disciples let us assemble
